app.tagline: Live test monitoring + periodic checks of all your linked keys
hdr.theme: Switch between light and dark mode
test.source: Source / website (where you got the key)
test.ready: Ready. Fill in Base URL and API Key, then press "Run test".
test.th_tps: Real generation speed — measured only when capability detection is on
test.empty_rows: Results will appear here live as soon as you run the test.
test.chart_empty: Results will show here after a run
keys.monitor_desc: Checks all keys on its own and alerts you when something changes
prov.models_ph: Fetched automatically when you test the keys
prov.import_desc: Add the keys saved in "My keys" as providers (one key per profile, grouped by URL).
gw.desc: Agents use this key. The gateway picks a real key that works, and if it fails or hits its limit, it moves on to the next one by itself. Real keys never leave the server.
gw.models_hint: Use the model name directly, or provider/model to force a specific provider.
agents.desc: "Enable" backs up the agent's settings, then writes the gateway URL and the local key into them. "Disable" restores the original settings. Restart the agent after any change. Click the picture to change it.
agents.desktop_note: Connected from inside the app, not with a button
agents.dg1: In the app: Help → Troubleshooting → Enable Developer Mode
agents.dg2: Then: Developer → Configure Third-Party Inference… and choose Gateway
agents.dg3: Fill in the values below, click Apply Changes, then Save & Restart
agents.dg4: On the sign-in screen, choose to start with the gateway settings (not your account). To go back to your account, choose to sign in with Anthropic.
agents.dg_note: In this mode the app works without your account: conversations are saved only on this computer, and this program must keep running.
agents.form_desc: Any tool that reads its URL and key from a JSON or .env file. Tell me where the file is and which fields it uses, and "Enable" will change only those fields (with a backup).
agents.name: Name
formats.title: 🧩 Custom formats (piagent, hermes, ...)
formats.desc: Enter a format name and paste a real JSON example of it with a baseURL and models — when you copy, the script automatically replaces baseURL, apiKey and the model list with each saved profile's details.
formats.name: Format name
settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
settings.toasts_sub: Alerts when a model changes or a key stops working
settings.monitor_sub: Periodic check of all linked keys
settings.lang_confirm_stop: A test is still running. Changing the language will stop it. Continue?
store.save_failed: Could not save on this computer
profile.provider_key: This key is stored in a provider; it can't be saved as a profile.
profile.fill_first: Fill in Base URL and API Key before saving.
paste.failed: Couldn't paste automatically — press Ctrl+V yourself.
keys.go_add: Fill in Base URL and API Key, run the test, then press "💾 Save current" to add it to "My keys".
keys.empty:
No saved keys yet.
Test a key in the "Test" tab and press "💾 Save current", or press "➕ Add a key".
keys.link_hint: Put the website URL in "Source" to turn this name into a link
keys.source_ph: Where did you get this key? (website URL)
copy.no_config: No config yet. Run the test first.
copy.run_first: Run the test first to get working models.
monitor.busy: A check is still running; wait until it finishes.
monitor.idle: Off. When on, it checks all keys on its own and alerts you when something changes.
row.enable_caps: Turn on capability detection to measure the real speed
run.fill: Fill in Base URL and API Key before running the test.
run.fill_toast: Fill in Base URL and API Key first.
run.stopped: Test stopped. {ok} working and {bad} failed before it stopped.
prov.empty:
No providers yet.
Add a provider with its URL, then add its keys.
prov.full_test: Full test in the Test tab
prov.models_later: Models are fetched when you test the keys.
prov.add_more_hint: (same URL; for several, one per line)
prov.rotation_help: ★ marks the key in use right now; every request goes to it. If it returns an error (rejected, limit reached, out of credit, or the service is down), the gateway switches to the next key within the same request without the agent noticing, and the failed key rests for a while before it is tried again.
addkeys.exists_only: ⛔ This key already exists: {list}. It can't be added twice.
addkeys.some_new: ⚠️ {n} new key(s) will be added. These already exist and will be skipped: {list}
addkeys.one_new: ✓ New key; press "Add key" or Ctrl+Enter
addkeys.many_new: ✓ {n} new keys; press "Add key" or Ctrl+Enter
addkeys.none_added: ⛔ Nothing added: the key already exists {list}.
addkeys.added: ✓ Added {n} key(s). Press "🧪 Test keys" to see whether they work.
prov.confirm_delete_key: Delete this key from the provider?
tester.from_provider: The key comes from the provider and stays on the server. Press "Run test".
gw.no_models: No models yet. Add a provider and test its keys.
gw.confirm_regen: Generate a new local key? The old key will stop working, and enabled agents will be updated automatically.
agents.claude_new: Once enabled, new Claude Code sessions in the terminal (claude) go through the gateway instead of your account.
agents.claude_note: The Claude desktop app sends its own account, so it isn't switched. Keep this program running, and in Claude Code type /status: it should show Anthropic base URL: 127.0.0.1.
agents.mark_shown_title: Tick every model the search shows
agents.filter_info: ☑ Only {shown} of {total} models are shown in this agent
agents.restart_hint: The agent was updated; restart it to load the settings.
agents.enabled_toast: Enabled. Restart the agent to load the settings.
agents.restored_exact: The original settings are back exactly as they were.
agents.restored_values: The original values are back (the file was changed elsewhere; your other edits were kept).
agents.confirm_delete: Remove agent "{name}" from the list? (Its file is not touched.)
srv.diag.KEY_INVALID: The key is invalid or not allowed to use this service.
srv.diag.LIMITED: The request or credit limit was reached; the model can't be judged right now.
srv.diag.TIMEOUT: The connection timed out before the service replied.
srv.diag.UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach the service; check the URL, your internet connection and the provider's status.
srv.diag.SERVER: The provider's service is temporarily unavailable; try again later.
srv.diag.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: This model isn't available for this key, or its name is wrong.
srv.diag.INCOMPATIBLE: The provider rejected the test request format; it may not support the compatible chat API.
srv.diag.INVALID_RESPONSE: A successful response arrived, but it holds no readable chat answer.
srv.list_unreadable: {url}: HTTP 200, but the model list format isn't understood
srv.need_url_key: Base URL and API Key are required.
srv.bad_scheme: Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
srv.not_numbers: Timeout, Retries, Workers and Repeat must be valid numbers.
srv.bad_ranges: Timeout, Workers and Repeat must be greater than zero, and Retries can't be negative.
srv.fetching: Fetching the list of available models...
srv.fallback: ⚠️ Couldn't get a fresh list ({error}) — using the last {n} model(s) known from an earlier successful check.
srv.fetch_failed: Couldn't fetch the models automatically ({error}). Type the model names into the manual models field and try again.
srv.model_crash: An unexpected error occurred while testing this model.
srv.key.VALID: The key works: at least one model gave a successful chat response.
srv.key.INVALID: The key was rejected or isn't allowed to use the tested models.
srv.key.LIMITED: The key can't be confirmed right now because of a usage or credit limit.
srv.key.UNCONFIRMED: The key couldn't be confirmed; check each model's diagnosis and the URL used.
srv.page_old: This page is out of date; press F5 to save.
err.provider_required: Name and a base URL starting with http:// or https:// are required.
err.no_keys: Add at least one key first.
err.no_model_list: No model list: add models manually.
err.not_enabled_by_gw: This agent was not enabled by the gateway.
err.hermes_missing: The hermes command was not found.
err.pick_model: Pick a model first (add a provider and test its keys to get models).
err.agent_path: The config path must be a full path (it can start with ~).
err.agent_path_dir: The config path points to a folder; give the file itself.
err.agent_fields: The URL field and the key field are required.
err.agent_field_env: Field '{field}' is not a valid .env variable.
err.agent_field_json: Field '{field}' is not a valid JSON path (a.b.c).
err.agent_disable_edit: Disable this agent before editing it.
err.agent_disable_delete: Disable this agent first, so its config goes back to the original.
note.changed_outside: Config was changed outside the gateway since it was enabled.
note.other_port: Enabled with a different port; press Enable again.
launcher.from_terminal: EskaGate is running from a terminal; stop it there with Ctrl+C.
launcher.port_busy: Port {port} is used by another program.
launcher.no_python: Python 3 was not found. Install it with: sudo apt install python3

install.removed: EskaGate was removed from the apps menu.

phone.title: 📱 Open on your phone
phone.closed: Phone access is closed, and the old link no longer works.
phone.here: 📱 You are on the phone right now.
phone.scan: Scan the code with your phone's camera. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the PC. The whole site will open.
phone.secret: 🔒 The link holds a secret key: don't share it. The phone remembers it after the first visit, and the PC always works without it.
phone.trouble_body: Make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi (not a guest network). If the Ubuntu firewall is on:
phone.stopped_body: The secret key changed; the old link and QR code no longer work.
phone.deny_lan: Access is only allowed from your home network.
phone.deny_token: 🔒 This link changed or is not valid. On the PC, press 📱 and scan the QR code again.
phone.err_no_lan: No local network (Wi-Fi) found. Make sure the PC is connected to the router.
tg.title: ✈️ Telegram alerts
tg.desc: A message when a key fails, when all of a provider's keys fail, when an agent goes quiet, and when everything is back to normal. It reaches you even when you're away.
tg.idle_label: Alert me when an agent is quiet for this many minutes (0 = off)
tg.summary_desc: One message per agent that had traffic: how many requests, how many tokens, and how many times its key was switched.
tg.help: 1) In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and copy the token. 2) Send /start to your bot, then press "🔎 Find it" to fill in the chat ID. 3) Save and test. 4) From Telegram: /status gives you the status, and /switch provider makes the next key the ★ key. Only the saved chat ID is answered. Messages hold only the provider name, the agent name and a masked key, never conversations or full keys. Leave a field empty to keep the saved value.
tg.fill_first: Fill in the bot token and the chat ID and press Save first
tg.saved_incomplete: Saved, but the token and the chat ID are still missing
tg.err_token: The bot token is not valid. Copy the whole token from @BotFather (like 123456:ABC...).
tg.err_chat: The chat ID must be a number (or @channel).
tg.err_minutes: The number of minutes must be a number.
tg.err_time: The summary time must look like 09:00.
tg.err_missing: Fill in the bot token and the chat ID first.
tg.test_msg: ✅ EskaGate: test message. Gateway alerts will arrive here.
tg.err_start_retry: Send /start to your bot in Telegram, then press again in a few seconds.
tg.err_no_message: No message found. Send /start to your bot in Telegram, then try again.
alert.no_next: ↪️ No other key left to try.
alert.quota_line: 📊 Last figures reported by the provider: {quota}

Since {start}: {requests} request(s) · {tokens} tokens · {switches} key switch(es){errors}

🤖 EskaGate
/status: status of every provider
/switch <provider>: make the next key the ★ key of this provider
bot.no_other_key: "{name}": no other key is available (they are all cooling down or rejected).

ah.title: 🔔 Alert history

effort.title: The gateway turns it into the provider's own parameter (reasoning_effort / thinking). If the provider rejects it, the request is sent without it.
